acs.text_first_line: Scenario: AC1 Shadow flags (legacy RWB-E1-062 AC1)
Scenario: AC3 A new document starts a run (legacy RWB-E1-062 AC3)
Scenario: AC4 The owner role comes from the rule rows (legacy RWB-E1-062 AC4)
Scenario: AC5 A complaint names the contact before it (legacy RWB-E1-062 AC5)
Scenario: AC6 A low-confidence proposal is marked for review (legacy RWB-E1-062 AC6)
Scenario: AC7 A repeated event (legacy RWB-E1-062 AC7)
Scenario: AC8 A code outside the list (legacy RWB-E1-062 AC8)

ops_provided: POST /api/recovery/agent/v1/agent-runs: start one screening run for one case and one triggering event through the rwb-agent contract (the path below the base is not named by a source; GAP-0615, ASM-0879)
GET /api/recovery/agent/v1/agent-runs/{runId}: read one run with its status, guardrail result and proposals (Arch v5 slide 16)
ops_consumed: rwb-case: the case read, the parameters contract (confidence floor, 30-day look-back, 180-day ledger window) and the reference-data lists LOV-DEVIATION, LOV-AGENT and LOV-AGENT-RUN (the parameter operation is not named by a source; ASM-0883)
rwb-deviation: the open deviations of the case, so a code already open is not proposed again
rwb-source-data: the interaction ledger entries of a case inside the window and the preceding contact of an X1 proposal (the operation is not named by a source; ASM-0880)
rwb-document: the documents of the case and their stored document_field values
rwb-decision: the rule package with R-DEV-02 to R-DEV-06 through the rule-model read of the embedded kit (ASM-0881)
INT-23: the Enterprise AI private endpoint, reached inside the agent platform of RWB-P10-E1058-APP
